description: User cannot log into their account
solution: Reset the authentication token and clear the browser cache.

description: Customer is unable to sign in
solution: Verify the account credentials and reset the password if necessary.

description: Payment failed while purchasing a subscription
solution: Check the payment method and retry the transaction.
Verify card details and contact the payment provider if the issue continues.

description: User account was locked after multiple failed login attempts
solution: Wait for the lockout period or reset the account through the administrator.
Use the password reset link to create a new password.
Clear the application cache and check server performance.
Check server logs and restart the affected service if necessary.

description: User is not receiving verification emails
solution: Check spam folders and verify that the email address is correct.

description: Customer cannot access their account because it is locked
solution: Verify the user's identity and unlock the account through the admin panel.

description: Login page keeps rejecting correct credentials
solution: Clear cached sessions and reset the authentication token.

description: Subscription payment did not go through
solution: Verify billing information and retry the payment.
Check spam folders and verify the registered email address.

description: Dashboard takes a long time to load
solution: Clear cache and investigate server response time.

description: API request returns an internal server error
solution: Review server logs and restart the affected API service.
